Package io.telekom.orchest.cache.blocking

Class GenericMongoCache<K,E,V>

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.cache.blocking.GenericMongoCache<K,E,V>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cache<K,V>
public class GenericMongoCache<K,E,V> extends Object implements Cache<K,V>
Copy-on-write Cache backed by an immutable snapshot held in an AtomicReference.

Read path: non-blocking AtomicReference.get() returns an immutable map. Readers never contend with refresh work.

Refresh path: serialized with a ReentrantLock tryLock so periodic and ad-hoc refreshes can never overlap. On success the new snapshot atomically replaces the old; on failure (and failSafe=true) the previous snapshot is retained.

Virtual threads drive async refresh() so callers aren't charged for I/O waits.
